disposition_reason: The signal and research family are fixed for source acquisition, but the available Zacks history is a 2018 sample and no qualifying prospective snapshot exists. This specification is not a ledger freeze, a holdout opening, or promotion evidence.
economic_hypothesis: A positive point-in-time EPS forecast error predicts positive post-announcement drift because prices incorporate earnings information gradually; a negative forecast error predicts negative drift.

formation_and_execution.entry_price: exact SEP.closeunadj on the next observed session is retained as contemporaneous execution-price evidence; SEP.close is retained as the split-normalized accounting basis
formation_and_execution.entry_timing: T+1: next observed SEP session close after the formation session
formation_and_execution.exit_price: mechanically reconstructed SEP.close value at the exact global observed trading-session horizon plus explicit entry-exclusive/exit-inclusive cash distributions without reinvestment; the target may not slide along ticker-local rows, closeadj remains diagnostic only, and qualification stays blocked until distribution field semantics are authoritatively sourced
formation_and_execution.formation_session: first observed SEP trading session of each calendar month
formation_and_execution.formation_visibility: announcement timestamp must be strictly before the actual formation-session close from the content-addressed official NYSE calendar; published 13:00 ET early closes replace the regular 16:00 ET cutoff, the formation bar must exist, and dates may not slide
formation_and_execution.session_close_calendar: nyse_session_close_calendar.json plus nyse_session_close_sources/receipt.json and its content-addressed raw HTML; each calendar row must be independently re-extracted from exact official ICE/NYSE source bytes covering the signal lookback, frozen formation window, and maximum exit padding

independent_source_binding.source_independence: Zacks announcement actuals and analyst estimates are independent of the Sharadar SF1 filing values used by the legacy development screen.

portfolio_rule.tie_break: ascending stable m_ticker after signal sort
portfolio_rule.universe: dated eligible US common-stock listings, including securities later delisted; identity is keyed by m_ticker rather than ticker alone

required_before_reconsideration: complete independent Zacks historical coverage and coverage report
actual-value and timestamp reconciliation to issuer releases or SEC Item 2.02 filings
authoritative ex-date, cash-per-share, currency, and split-basis evidence for every modeled distribution
separately sourced terminal settlement terms for every held delisting or successor chain
reconciliation of independently written vectorized and event-driven implementations
sealed prospective signal evidence accumulated after a ledger freeze
dated borrow and locate evidence for every short
calibrated spread, slippage, impact, commission, financing, and dividend costs

signal_rule.actual_eps_field: ZACKS/ES.eps_act on the provider's split-restated per-share basis
signal_rule.announcement_timestamp: ZACKS/ES.act_rpt_date plus act_rpt_time interpreted in America/New_York and reconciled to act_rpt_code
signal_rule.consensus_cross_check: ZACKS/ES.eps_mean_est must be compared with the reconstructed EEH vintage; an absolute difference greater than USD 0.01 per share is retained as a discrepancy and blocks event eligibility pending resolution
signal_rule.consensus_vintage_rule: latest EEH row with matching m_ticker, per_end_date, and per_type and obs_date strictly earlier than act_rpt_date; same-day vintages are excluded because EEH has no intraday vintage time
signal_rule.missing_or_ambiguous_data: fail closed; do not impute actual EPS, consensus, analyst count, event timestamp, identifier, or price
signal_rule.per_share_basis: Zacks historical actuals and estimates are split-restated (for example, the 2018 AAPL values reflect the later 4:1 split). SEP.close is therefore the matching split-normalized denominator; SEP.closeunadj is separately preserved as contemporaneous execution evidence and must never replace the denominator without reconstructing the EPS share basis.
signal_rule.preannouncement_price: the most recent positive split-normalized SHARADAR/SEP close whose actual regular-session close timestamp from the bound official NYSE calendar is strictly before the announcement timestamp, with an exact same-session SEP.closeunadj execution-evidence value
signal_rule.revenue_role: ZACKS/SS and ZACKS/SEH are required for source completeness and a separately reported revenue-surprise diagnostic; revenue may not alter the EPS primary signal or selection rule in this protocol
signal_rule.timing_conflicts: act_rpt_time and act_rpt_code must agree; BTO means before open, DTM during market, and AMC after close. Missing or contradictory timing is ineligible.

statistical_family.correction: Benjamini-Hochberg across the exact eight-cell family
statistical_family.economic_returns: mechanical candidates use exact SEP.close exit value plus explicit cash distributions without reinvestment; closeadj remains a separate diagnostic, the current ACTIONS dividend interpretation is nonqualifying pending authoritative semantics, and robust arrays may not replace executable economics
statistical_family.inference: one-sided positive-spread HAC inference with dependence length covering the holding horizon
statistical_family.robustness_diagnostic: one-percent within-formation return winsorization reported separately from raw economics
statistical_family.size_slices: dated market-cap terciles formed independently at each formation session

stop_rules: stop if the independently reconstructed primary signal reverses sign
stop if no cost-net cell survives the frozen BH family
stop if the pooled 63-session cost-net spread is nonpositive
stop if timestamp, identifier, actual-value, consensus-vintage, corporate-action, or delisting discrepancies remain unresolved
stop if the executable borrowable portfolio materially differs from the researched book
